title: Akathist Convent vs Celeritas Squadron
lede:
Akathist Convent won 34-23 on Victory Points at the end of Battle Round 5, with the left and right objectives in its hands at the end.

Caesar and the Palatine Custos (Mounted) took the centre from Round 3 and held it, but a 10 RP Covenant Levies bought with Troop Requisition walked onto the empty right objective and held it for three rounds, and the Squadron never had a second unit to take a flank.
result_line: Akathist Convent win 34-23 on Victory Points in Battle Round 5
deployment: Central Faceoff on CROSSROADS, three objectives on row 7: the 3 VP centre at (7,7) and the 2 VP flanks at (1,7) and (13,7). The Akathist Convent lined up on row 12 in front of its HQ at (7,13): Covenant Levies 3 and 4 at (3,12) and (4,12), the Abbatissa Dolorosa with the Maphorion Nuns at (5,12), Covenant Levies 2 at (7,12), the Field Confessor with Covenant Levies 1 at (9,12), the Saint-Militant at (10,12) and the Seven-Sword Intercessor with the Myrrhbearer Sisters at (11,12). The Celeritas Squadron fielded four units around its HQ at (7,1): Caesar - Divus Imperator (Mounted) with the Palatine Custos (Mounted) at (9,1), Retiarius Squad 2 at (3,2), and the Comitatus Armored Carrier at (5,1) carrying Retiarius Squad 1 and the Legionnaire Squad. Ten Convent units against six: the Convent had the bodies for three objectives, the Squadron the hardest-hitting pair on the table. The Squadron had Priority every round (fewer units on the battlefield).

1.title: The Saint-Militant holds the centre at 2 HP

feed.text: Primaries revealed: ERADICATE THE FOE for the Convent, BREAK THEIR HOLD for the Squadron. Secondaries kept: LAST STAND and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY. The Abbatissa's Mantle of Mercy went on herself, the Maphorion Nuns and the Saint-Militant. Neither side spent CP.

Retiarius Squad 2 ran to 1,6 on the left and Caesar with the Palatine Custos to 8,7 on the centre. The Comitatus Armored Carrier drove to 7,5 and unloaded Retiarius Squad 1 and the Legionnaire Squad; Retiarius Squad 1 charged Covenant Levies 2 at 4,7. For the Convent the Maphorion Nuns reached 2,8 on the left, Covenant Levies 1 with the Field Confessor 6,8 and the Saint-Militant 7,7 on the centre, taking 1 from the Carrier's Overwatch.

The Legionnaire Squad shot the Saint-Militant for 4 (6 to 2), with the Convent's Fortitude Miracle spent on the attack. Retiarius Squad 1 put 8 into Covenant Levies 2 and took 2. PRAYING paid the Convent 9 Mana.

The Convent took the centre on an 11-11 OC tie by units in the area and the left on OC 7 vs 3, 5 VP. LAST STAND completed for 3, with the Saint-Militant Below Half-Strength on the centre. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Squadron 2 for Retiarius Squad 2 and Caesar's pair standing in the two areas. 8-2.

2.title: The Nuns destroy the Legionnaire Squad

feed.text: The Benediction Miracle healed the Saint-Militant 5. The Convent spent 3 CP on Troop Requisition: Covenant Levies at 8,12. The Squadron spent 2 CP on Secure Objective for the Palatine Custos, which bought nothing. Secondaries kept: FOCUSED FIRE and IRON CURTAIN.

Retiarius Squad 1 broke away from Covenant Levies 2 to 4,4. The Carrier drove to 8,8 and Covenant Levies 1's Overwatch hit it for 5 (Providence Miracle; the Squadron answered with Go to Ground through Caesar, 0 CP). Caesar and the Custos charged Covenant Levies 2 and 3 at 7,6. The Saint-Militant and the Maphorion Nuns charged the Legionnaire Squad at 2,6.

The Custos and Caesar put 18 into Covenant Levies 3 (20 to 2). The Abbatissa cast Agnus Dei on the Nuns (6 Mana, +1 DMG) and the Nuns destroyed the Legionnaire Squad through its Shield Wall, 10 damage, then took ground to 2,6. Retiarius Squad 2's Net Launcher IMMOBILIZED the Nuns and the Abbatissa. Covenant Levies 1 shot the Carrier down to 3 HP. The Field Confessor cast Sanctus on Covenant Levies 1 (3 Mana).
The Convent held the centre on OC 18 vs 16 and the left on OC 10 vs 0, 5 VP, and ERADICATE THE FOE paid 2 for the Legionnaire Squad. BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Squadron 1. 15-3.

3.title: Caesar takes the centre; a Requisitioned levy takes the right

feed.text: Covenant Levies 3 failed Morale and was SUPPRESSED. The Squadron spent 1 CP on Double Time for Retiarius Squad 2 and 1 on Rally Cry for the Carrier; the Convent 2 CP on Double Time for its new Covenant Levies. Secondaries kept: IRON GRIP and INTO THE FRAY.

Retiarius Squad 2 moved onto the centre at 8,6. Retiarius Squad 1 charged Covenant Levies 3 at 5,5 and completed INTO THE FRAY, +2; the Levies failed their Fall Back test and broke away in disorder to 5,8. The Requisitioned Covenant Levies used its Double Time to reach 12,7, inside the empty right objective's area.

The Custos (10) and Caesar (2) destroyed Covenant Levies 2 on the centre. The Field Confessor cast Gloria on Covenant Levies 1 (4 Mana); the Carrier shot them for 5. The Myrrhbearer Sisters destroyed the Carrier. Retiarius Squad 2's Net Launcher IMMOBILIZED the Field Confessor and Covenant Levies 1. The Abbatissa channelled 5 Mana.

The Squadron took the centre on OC 14 vs 8 (3 VP) and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 3 for taking it. The Convent held the left (OC 10 vs 0) and the right (OC 10 vs 0), 4 VP; ERADICATE THE FOE paid 2 for the Carrier and IRON GRIP 2 and 1 CP. 23-11.

4.title: The Convent leaves the left; four units die in the centre

feed.text: The Convent spent 3 CP on Secure Objective for the Maphorion Nuns and the Squadron 2 CP on Secure Objective for Retiarius Squad 2; neither bought anything. Secondaries kept: PUSH FORWARD and DEEP REACH.

The centre became one melee: Retiarius Squad 1 charged the Field Confessor and Covenant Levies 1 at 7,7, Covenant Levies 4 charged Retiarius Squad 1, Retiarius Squad 2 charged Covenant Levies 4, and Caesar with the Custos charged the Myrrhbearer Sisters, the Seven-Sword Intercessor and Covenant Levies 4 at 8,8. The Saint-Militant left the left objective to charge Retiarius Squad 1 at 6,7, and the Nuns with the Abbatissa walked off it to 5,6, leaving the left empty.

The Custos (12) and Retiarius Squad 2 (8) destroyed Covenant Levies 4. The Convent used the Retribution Miracle and the Abbatissa cast Agnus Dei on Covenant Levies 1 (6 Mana). Caesar put 8 into the Myrrhbearer Sisters, and the counterattack took 5 off the Custos; the Seven-Sword Intercessor took Retiarius Squad 2 from 15 to 2. Retiarius Squad 1 hit Covenant Levies 1 for 10, and Covenant Levies 1 and the Saint-Militant took it down to 7.

The Squadron held the centre on OC 15 vs 6 (3 VP). Nobody held the left, which the Convent had held at the start of the round, so BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Squadron 3. DEEP REACH paid it 3 more. The Convent's only objective was the right (2 VP). 25-20.

The Convent spent 3 CP on Troop Requisition (Covenant Levies #2 at 7,12). The Squadron spent 2 CP on Secure Objective for the Custos and 1 on Rally Cry for Retiarius Squad 2. Secondaries kept: TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY and STRONGPOINT; the Squadron's TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY, kept in Round 1, expired.

Retiarius Squad 2 failed its Fall Back test and broke away in disorder to 9,8. Covenant Levies 3 walked back onto the left at 2,6. The Maphorion Nuns charged Retiarius Squad 1 at 7,6. The Myrrhbearer Sisters failed their Fall Back test and were destroyed breaking away; the Seven-Sword Intercessor then fell back on its own to 5,8.

Retiarius Squad 1 netted the Nuns, and Caesar shot Covenant Levies #2 for 6. The Field Confessor cast Agnus Dei on the Abbatissa (6 Mana) and the Nuns destroyed Retiarius Squad 1 (8). The Abbatissa cast Gloria on Covenant Levies 1 (4 Mana).

The Squadron held the centre on OC 15 vs 13, the Secure Objective deciding it. The Convent took the left on OC 1 vs 0 and the right on OC 10 vs 0, 4 VP; ERADICATE THE FOE paid 2 for Retiarius Squad 1 and TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY 3. 34-23, the Convent past 30.

analysis.title: Why it went this way
analysis.html:
Where the VP came from

The Akathist Convent scored 20 objective VP: the centre and left in Rounds 1 and 2, then the flanks. ERADICATE THE FOE paid 6 (the Legionnaire Squad, the Carrier and Retiarius Squad 1, each killed in an Objective Area) and three secondaries 8 (LAST STAND 3, IRON GRIP 2, TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY 3). The Celeritas Squadron scored 9 objective VP, the centre in Rounds 3 to 5, and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid it as much again, 9: 2 and 1 for standing in Convent objectives, then 3 for taking the centre and 3 for the left the Convent left. INTO THE FRAY and DEEP REACH added 5.

{{chart:objectives}}

What the key units did

The Convent's top scorer was a 10 RP unit that did not exist at deployment: the Covenant Levies bought with Troop Requisition in Round 2 took the right objective with a Double Time in Round 3 and held it to the end, 8.3 VP, 6 of them hinged on it. The Maphorion Nuns destroyed the Legionnaire Squad and Retiarius Squad 1 (18 damage, 2 kills) and were behind 4 of the 6 ERADICATE THE FOE VP. The Seven-Sword Intercessor did 18 damage, 13 of it in one Round 4 fight with Retiarius Squad 2. The Abbatissa and the Field Confessor spent 29 Mana on Antiphons (Agnus Dei three times, Gloria twice, Sanctus), most of it on Covenant Levies 1.

For the Squadron, the Palatine Custos (Mounted) did 30 damage and Caesar 26: the pair destroyed Covenant Levies 2 and, with Retiarius Squad 2, Covenant Levies 4, and with OC 2 a model it held the centre on OC 14 and 15 from Round 3. Each scored 5.8 VP. Go to Ground through Caesar cost the Squadron nothing three times.

{{chart:attrition}}

What the Squadron could not do

It had one unit that could hold ground against the Convent, and that unit was on the centre. Its other OC, the Legionnaire Squad and the two Retiarius Squads, went into melee instead: the Legionnaires died on the left in Round 2, Retiarius Squad 1 in the centre in Round 5, and Retiarius Squad 2 ended the battle on 4 HP of 15. Nothing of the Squadron's ever stood on the right objective, which the Convent held for three rounds with a 10 RP squad. TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY, kept in Round 1, needed it to hold more objectives than the Convent and expired. The two armies lost about the same (55 RP to 79), so the result was where they stood, not what they killed.

{{chart:rp-trade}}

The AI, not the army

  • Round 4, the left objective: the Convent's AI spent 3 CP on Secure Objective for the Maphorion Nuns, then walked the Nuns, the Abbatissa and the Saint-Militant off the left. Nobody held it at the end of the round: the Convent lost its 2 VP and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid the Squadron 3. That 5 VP swing was the Squadron's best round.
  • Covenant Levies 4 moved toward the right objective and then away from it in Rounds 1 to 3 (two moves undone, 5 squares lost by the record), then charged Retiarius Squad 1 in Round 4 and was destroyed.
  • Round 5, the Myrrhbearer Sisters and the Seven-Sword Intercessor, a joined pair, made two Fall Back decisions: the Sisters failed and died breaking away, and the Intercessor then rolled its own test and got away. The record calls both doubtful in a round where surviving was worth nothing.
  • Secure Objective bought nothing in Rounds 2 and 4 for the Squadron and in Round 4 for the Convent; the Squadron's Round 5 use decided the centre (6 VP by the record).

The army decided most of it: ten Convent units against six, and only one of the six built to hold ground. The Convent's AI gave back 5 VP in Round 4, which made it close, not lost.

Against the first playing

The first playing went to the Akathist Convent 32-4 in Round 4. The Celeritas Squadron then fielded Malleus Sappers and one Retiarius Squad; now it brought a second Retiarius Squad and a Legionnaire Squad, with the Palatine Custos (Mounted) at OC 2 a model and Caesar and the Custos 10 RP cheaper each. It scored no objective VP in the first playing and 9 this time, all from the Custos and Caesar on the centre, and BREAK THEIR HOLD paid 9 where it paid 4. The Convent's objective VP fell from 26 to 20 and the battle went a round longer.

closing: Caesar and his Custos were the strongest unit on the table and they took the centre, but a battle on three objectives went to the army that could stand on the other two. A 10 RP Covenant Levies held the right for three rounds, and the Squadron's light squads spent themselves in melee in the middle.
